parameters.query: SELECT id, first_name, last_name, profile_url, email_address, company, position, connected_at FROM s_linkedin.connections WHERE processed = 0 LIMIT 100;

INSERT INTO cdp.leads (person_id, full_name, description, status, source)
SELECT
  (SELECT id FROM cdp.persons WHERE linkedin_url = '{{ $json.sql_profile_url }}' LIMIT 1),
  TRIM(CONCAT({{ $json.sql_first_name ? "'" + $json.sql_first_name + "'" : "''" }}, ' ', {{ $json.sql_last_name ? "'" + $json.sql_last_name + "'" : "''" }})),
  {{ $json.sql_position ? "'Position: ' || '" + $json.sql_position + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  'prospect',
  '{{ $json.source }}';
